Chiropractor Dr. Craig Mix, DC is a wellness family chiropractic doctor at Discover Chiropractic.  Specializing in chiropractic care and wellness in Birmingham and Trussville, Dr. Craig Mix is committed to providing pain relief for many symptoms and conditions so that you can have a higher quality of life.
 
Call us to learn how you can reduce your back or neck pain, sciatica, depression, Fibromyalgia, and headaches.  Or perhaps you are looking for a safe and fast weight loss system in Birmingham or Trussville?  We can help you.  Make this year a healthier year!
